description: This Java source file defines a final class `MockDatabase` that provides static methods to access mock data objects representing various notification styles used in an Android application, such as BigTextStyle, BigPictureStyle, InboxStyle, and MessagingStyle. Within it, there are nested classes for each data type, encapsulating sample notification data including titles, texts, images, responses, and messages, primarily for demo or testing purposes.

classes.name: MockDatabase
classes.description: A utility class providing static accessors for mock notification data objects.

classes.name: BigTextStyleReminderAppData
classes.description: Holds data for a BigTextStyle notification, including titles and text content.

classes.name: BigPictureStyleSocialAppData
classes.description: Contains data for a BigPictureStyle notification with images and responses.

classes.name: InboxStyleEmailAppData
classes.description: Represents email inbox style notification data including summaries and participant info.

classes.name: MessagingStyleCommsAppData
classes.description: Stores messaging style notification data, including message history and participants.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Singleton accessor for each data class.
